title: NikeSKIMS Introduces Outerwear and Adds a Bold Red Colorway to Its Latest Collection
summary: NikeSKIMS is introducing its first outerwear, pairing body-contouring foundations with more ways to layer for the shift into cooler weather, all with a distinctly feminine point of view.
body_markdown:
NikeSKIMS is introducing its first outerwear, pairing body-contouring foundations with more ways to layer for the shift into cooler weather, all with a distinctly feminine point of view.


The addition of outerwear advances NikeSKIMS’[head-to-toe system of dress](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/nikeskims-spring-2026-collection-official-images) that’s[designed to sculpt and engineered to perform](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/nikeskims-official-announcement) , working in unison to give women more ways to transition seamlessly between movement and everyday wear.


Outerwear will be available across two new material franchises:


- **Sherpa** introduces soft, warm layers designed to complement pieces across the NikeSKIMS wardrobe. The franchise includes a vest, half-zip jacket and hooded jacket that combine high-pile Nike Therma-FIT material with a soft brushed interior and recycled nylon contrast panels.
- **Crunchy Nylon** brings a more structured expression. Its water-repellent fabric has a textured face that creates volume and shape across a cropped jacket, hooded parka, 2-inch short and wide-leg pants.


“With NikeSKIMS, we want women to feel confident and put together, and this collection takes that even further,” says Kim Kardashian, Co-Founder and Chief Creative Officer, SKIMS. “The outerwear adds a whole new layer to the wardrobe and gives women even more ways to style NikeSKIMS throughout their day. I’m especially excited about the University Red colorway. It’s bold, effortless and brings so much energy to the collection.”


University Red is this season’s defining new color, energizing the palette and showing up across Matte, Weightless Layers, Performance Cotton Blend, Crunchy Nylon, footwear and accessories.


Returning franchises, including Weightless Layers, Stretch Nylon, Performance Cotton Blend, Stretch Knit, Matte and Airy, round out the collection with lightweight, breathable and moisture-wicking pieces available in additional colorways.


The Matte material collection will expand this season with new body-contouring bras. Stretch Knit will also debut new styles fabricated in a single-layer seamless yarn that creates a beautiful drape and fit.


Further, the[NikeSKIMS Rift Satin](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/nikeskims-spring-2026-collection-official-images) debuts new Shadow Brown and University Red colorways this season alongside the returning Silt Red.


The collection’s bold styles and colors come to life through a campaign featuring the cheer team from the University of Alabama,[a three-decade, all-sport Nike partner](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/nike-and-alabama-expand-their-three-decade-partnership-with-18-blue-ribbon-elite-nil-signings) and the reigning UCA Division 1A cheerleading champion.


The launch also follows NikeSKIMS’ expansion into China, which brings the brand’s distinctive perspective to one of the world’s most influential markets for sport, style and culture. As the latest step in NikeSKIMS’ continued global growth, the expansion underscores the brand’s commitment to bringing its sport-style innovation to new audiences around the world.


The new NikeSKIMS fall styles will be available globally October 22 at[nike.com/NikeSKIMS](https://www.nike.com/NikeSKIMS) and[SKIMS.com/NikeSKIMS.](https://skims.com/collections/nikeskims) Select Nike, SKIMS and partner retail locations will follow.
